gloss: as scheduled; as planned; on schedule

definitions.gloss: as scheduled; as planned; on schedule
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something proceeds exactly according to the original plan or schedule, without changes or delays.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}は{予定通|よていどお}り{始|はじ}まった。
{工事|こうじ}は{予定通|よていどお}り{進|すす}んでいます。
examples.english: The construction is progressing on schedule.

examples.japanese: {天候|てんこう}が{悪|わる}かったが、{運動会|うんどうかい}は{予定通|よていどお}り{開催|かいさい}された。
examples.english: The weather was bad, but the sports festival was held as planned.

notes:
USAGE:
{予定通|よていどお}り can function as an adverb modifying a verb, or as a noun with に or の. It is one of the most common ～{通|どお}り expressions.

COMMON PATTERNS:
The ～{通|どお}り pattern attaches to nouns to mean "as (noun)." Other common examples: {計画通|けいかくどお}り (as planned), {期待通|きたいどお}り (as expected), {説明通|せつめいどお}り (as explained).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {予定通|よていどお}り{進|すす}む (to proceed on schedule)
- {予定通|よていどお}り{開催|かいさい}する (to hold as scheduled)
- {予定通|よていどお}り{届|とど}く (to arrive on time)
